summary.text: David Hill is the Republican candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 50, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He defeated Levi Asay in the Republican primary on August 18, 2026.
Hill is an attorney in Cody.

paragraphs.text: David Hill earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University–Idaho in 2013 and a graduate degree and law degree from the University of Wyoming in 2019.
He ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost the Republican primary on August 20, 2024, to incumbent Rachel Rodriguez-Williams.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Hill described himself as a husband, father of three boys, attorney and small business leader in Cody, and said he serves as president of the Cody Country Chamber of Commerce.
He said his priorities include limited government, individual liberty and local control, protecting public lands, and supporting rural communities, families and small businesses.
